notes.title: New Environment & Fresh Skins – Lustful Fingers Major Update
notes.content: [h2]🌟 Major Update is Here![/h2][p]We’ve just rolled out one of the biggest updates for [b]Lustful Fingers[/b] so far, bringing both visual improvements and new customization features.[/p][h3]🏠 New Environment[/h3][p]Enjoy a fully redesigned spa environment with improved atmosphere, lighting, and immersive details that elevate the massage experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454735/6ff25f44f235630ba012ca597a92724ed0004005.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎨 Fresh Skin Variations[/h3][p]Multiple new skin options for your clients, adding more variety and realism to your sessions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454735/15a10023b928a0e0d0776579a537361c372d4a7a.png"][/img][/p][h3]⚡ What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re continuing to expand Lustful Fingers with more therapies, animations, and customer interactions in the coming updates. Stay tuned![/p][hr][/hr][p]👉 Dive back in and experience the new look & feel today![/p]
